brief: Stops the two milder strengths of poison (including a Toadstool's) and turns Deadly Poison into the middle strength: 3 HP per second instead of 5. Poisonous ground no longer tops your poison up.
Each poison tick takes twice the health (Deadly Poison: 10 HP per second); how long poison lasts is unchanged. Wellness or a Pyroscale Talisman cancels it.
Blocks paralysis completely, from monster attacks and from a bad Exciteshroom, so a paralysing hit becomes an ordinary hit.
Paralysis lasts twice as long: 8.67 s instead of 4.33 s. Mashing buttons still shortens it, but there is twice as much to get through.
Sleep hits from monsters build up nothing, so you never fall asleep; sleep attacks become ordinary hits.
Sleep lasts 16 s instead of 8 s. How quickly sleep builds up is unchanged.
Stunning hits never build up toward a stun, so you are never stunned. Halve Stun adds nothing on top.
Each time stun build-up is full, there is a 1 in 2 chance you are not stunned and the build-up resets to 0. Does nothing alongside Negate Stun.
Mashing out of a stun takes twice the inputs (74 instead of 37). Each stage still ends on its own after 12.5 s, and you are not stunned more often.
Blocks every monster roar, small and large grade, so you never cover your ears. Covers everything Earplugs does, and Alchemy Earplugs are never used up.
Blocks only the small grade of monster roars; large roars still make you cover your ears and need HG Earplugs.
Blocks small and large wind pressure. The strongest grade still affects you, but only with the milder large-wind reaction.
Blocks only the small grades of wind pressure; large and strongest wind pressure affect you exactly as without the skill.
Blocks both kinds of tremor reaction, so you no longer stagger when a large monster shakes the ground.
Bind attacks that would hold you for 4 s or 6 s become a plain hit, bubbles never reach their second stage, and several other states that hold or restrict you are blocked.
Removes all health loss from heat, in hot areas and on hot ground, and red health keeps recovering on hot ground. Heat Surge has no effect alongside it.
Heat drains health twice as fast, in hot areas and on hot ground. No effect with Heat Cancel, Tropic Hunter or Steelshell Talisman; a Cool Drink cancels the hot-area part.
Cold takes no health but makes maximum stamina shrink faster; this removes that extra speed, so a cold area costs no more stamina than a warm one. Cold Surge has no effect alongside it.
In cold areas maximum stamina shrinks much faster (the cold part is doubled), so you must eat more often. No effect with Cold Cancel, Polar Hunter, Hazefur Talisman or a Hot Drink.
In cold areas: +15 attack, +20 defense and no cold stamina loss (as Cold Cancel). While a Cool Drink is in effect: +5 attack anywhere.
In hot areas: +15 attack, +20 defense and no heat health loss (as Heat Cancel). While a Hot Drink is in effect: +10 defense anywhere.
Monsters can never steal your items, so you never have to chase a thief to get them back.
Blocks both Defense Down effects from monster attacks: the lesser (defense x0.8) and the greater (x0.5), each normally lasting 3 min.
Each hit does more to overcome the Frenzy virus (+5 progress, so small hits count double), and overcoming it gives +30% affinity instead of +15%. It does not make infection less likely.
Everything Bio Researcher does (blocks Stench and Blastblight; dung projectiles carry 180 dung value instead of 100), and a full Frenzy infection ends after 48 s instead of 60 s.
Blocks Stench and Blastblight, including the Stench from a bad Exciteshroom, and dung projectiles carry 180 dung value instead of 100.
Bleeding hits build up nothing, so you never start bleeding (normally 2 HP lost each second); bleeding attacks become ordinary hits.
Bleeding takes 4 HP each second instead of 2. The build-up and how long bleeding lasts are unchanged.
+20 attack, added before every multiplier, so Fortify, Adrenaline +2, Dragonheart and the rest multiply it too. Only one Attack skill applies.
+15 attack, added before every multiplier, so Fortify, Adrenaline +2, Dragonheart and the rest multiply it too. Only one Attack skill applies.
+10 attack, added before every multiplier, so Fortify, Adrenaline +2, Dragonheart and the rest multiply it too. Only one Attack skill applies.
-5 attack, taken off before every multiplier, so the loss grows with Fortify, Adrenaline +2 and the rest. Only one Attack skill applies.
-10 attack, taken off before every multiplier, so the loss grows with Fortify, Adrenaline +2 and the rest. Only one Attack skill applies.
-15 attack, taken off before every multiplier, so the loss grows with Fortify, Adrenaline +2 and the rest. Only one Attack skill applies.
Base defense x1.06, then +25 (base 300: 344 instead of 301), applied before Fortify and every other bonus. The percentage part grows with your base defense.
Base defense x1.03, then +20 (base 300: 330 instead of 301), applied before Fortify and every other bonus. The percentage part grows with your base defense.
+15 defense (base 300: 316 instead of 301), the same at every base defense, applied before Fortify and every other bonus.
-10 defense (base 300: 291 instead of 301), the same at every base defense, applied before Fortify and every other bonus.
Base defense x0.95, then -10 (base 300: 276 instead of 301), applied before Fortify and every other bonus. The loss grows with your base defense.
Base defense x0.9, then -10 (base 300: 261 instead of 301), applied before Fortify and every other bonus. The loss grows with your base defense.
Maximum health 150 instead of 100. That is already the 150 cap, so any other health bonus is wasted.
Maximum health 120 instead of 100. Other health bonuses add on top, up to the 150 cap.
Maximum health 90 instead of 100. Other health bonuses still add on top.
Maximum health 70 instead of 100, so hits that would leave you at low health can cart you.
+20 Fire resistance: Fire attacks do 20% less damage, and reaching 15 resistance makes Fireblight milder, 25 prevents it. Only one Fire Res skill applies.
+15 Fire resistance: Fire attacks do 15% less damage, and reaching 15 resistance makes Fireblight milder, 25 prevents it. Only one Fire Res skill applies.
-20 Fire resistance: Fire attacks do 20% more damage, and Fireblight is harder to avoid (below 15 resistance, most Fire attacks give the stronger blight).
+20 Water resistance: Water attacks do 20% less damage, and reaching 15 resistance makes Waterblight milder, 25 prevents it. Only one Water Res skill applies.
+15 Water resistance: Water attacks do 15% less damage, and reaching 15 resistance makes Waterblight milder, 25 prevents it. Only one Water Res skill applies.
-20 Water resistance: Water attacks do 20% more damage, and Waterblight is harder to avoid (below 15 resistance, most Water attacks give the stronger blight).
+20 Thunder resistance: Thunder attacks do 20% less damage, and reaching 15 resistance makes Thunderblight milder, 25 prevents it. Only one Thunder Res skill applies.
+15 Thunder resistance: Thunder attacks do 15% less damage, and reaching 15 resistance makes Thunderblight milder, 25 prevents it. Only one Thunder Res skill applies.
-20 Thunder resistance: Thunder attacks do 20% more damage, and Thunderblight is harder to avoid (below 15 resistance, most Thunder attacks give the stronger blight).
+20 Ice resistance: Ice attacks do 20% less damage, and reaching 15 resistance makes Iceblight (also from icy ground) milder, 25 prevents it. Only one Ice Res skill applies.
+15 Ice resistance: Ice attacks do 15% less damage, and reaching 15 resistance makes Iceblight (also from icy ground) milder, 25 prevents it. Only one Ice Res skill applies.
-20 Ice resistance: Ice attacks do 20% more damage, and Iceblight is harder to avoid (below 15 resistance, most Ice attacks give the stronger blight).
+20 Dragon resistance: Dragon attacks do 20% less damage, and reaching 15 resistance makes Dragonblight milder, 25 prevents it. Only one Dragon Res skill applies.
+15 Dragon resistance: Dragon attacks do 15% less damage, and reaching 15 resistance makes Dragonblight milder, 25 prevents it. Only one Dragon Res skill applies.
-20 Dragon resistance: Dragon attacks do 20% more damage, and Dragonblight is harder to avoid (below 15 resistance, most Dragon attacks give the stronger blight).
Blocks all five elemental blights at both levels from monster attacks, and Iceblight from icy ground. It does not stop Blastblight or the Dragonblight that Dragonheart puts on you.
Fire element x1.1, then +6, also on Fire shots (Flaming S) and Fire arrows. Element multipliers together are capped at x1.2, but the +6 is added after the cap.
Fire element x1.05, then +4, also on Fire shots (Flaming S) and Fire arrows. Stacks in full with Element Atk Up (x1.155, under the x1.2 cap).
Fire element x0.75 with nothing added, also on Fire shots (Flaming S) and Fire arrows. Element Atk Up only softens it to x0.825.
Water element x1.1, then +6, also on Water shots (Water S) and Water arrows. Element multipliers together are capped at x1.2, but the +6 is added after the cap.
Water element x1.05, then +4, also on Water shots (Water S) and Water arrows. Stacks in full with Element Atk Up (x1.155, under the x1.2 cap).
Water element x0.75 with nothing added, also on Water shots (Water S) and Water arrows. Element Atk Up only softens it to x0.825.
Thunder element x1.1, then +6, also on Thunder shots (Thunder S) and Thunder arrows. Element multipliers together are capped at x1.2, but the +6 is added after the cap.
Thunder element x1.05, then +4, also on Thunder shots (Thunder S) and Thunder arrows. Stacks in full with Element Atk Up (x1.155, under the x1.2 cap).
Thunder element x0.75 with nothing added, also on Thunder shots (Thunder S) and Thunder arrows. Element Atk Up only softens it to x0.825.
Ice element x1.1, then +6, also on Ice shots (Freeze S) and Ice arrows. Element multipliers together are capped at x1.2, but the +6 is added after the cap.
Ice element x1.05, then +4, also on Ice shots (Freeze S) and Ice arrows. Stacks in full with Element Atk Up (x1.155, under the x1.2 cap).
Ice element x0.75 with nothing added, also on Ice shots (Freeze S) and Ice arrows. Element Atk Up only softens it to x0.825.
Dragon element x1.1, then +6, also on Dragon shots (Dragon S), Dragon arrows and one Switch Axe phial path. Element multipliers together are capped at x1.2; the +6 is added after.
Dragon element x1.05, then +4, also on Dragon shots (Dragon S), Dragon arrows and one Switch Axe phial path. Stacks in full with Element Atk Up (x1.155, under the x1.2 cap).
Dragon element x0.75 with nothing added, also on Dragon shots (Dragon S), Dragon arrows and one Switch Axe phial path. Element Atk Up only softens it to x0.825.
All five elements x1.1, also on elemental shots, arrows and one Switch Axe phial path; status and Blast are untouched. Element multipliers together are capped at x1.2.
All five elements x0.9, also on elemental shots, arrows and one Switch Axe phial path. It does nothing if Element Atk Up or Elementality is also active.

Poison, paralysis and sleep buildup x1.2, then +1, on your weapon, shots, arrows, Bow coatings and Switch Axe status phials. With Felyne Specialist the total is capped at x1.25. Blast is not affected.
Poison, paralysis and sleep buildup x1.1, then +1, on your weapon, shots, arrows, Bow coatings and Switch Axe status phials. Stacks almost in full with Felyne Specialist. Blast is not affected.
Poison, paralysis and sleep buildup x0.9 with nothing added, on your weapon, shots, arrows, Bow coatings and Switch Axe status phials. Blast is not affected.
Sharpening takes one whetstone stroke instead of four: 1.97 s instead of 4.33 s, with the same amount restored. Gunners only benefit with Heavy Polish.
Sharpening takes one extra stroke: 5.1 s instead of 4.33 s, with the same amount restored. Hellblade Soul and Hellblade Soul X override it.
Raises the weapon's sharpness level by 2: up to +50 sharpness points (about 50 more normal hits), never past the 450 maximum. Does not add to Sharpness +1; no effect for gunners.
Raises the weapon's sharpness level by 1: up to +25 sharpness points (about 25 more normal hits), nothing on a weapon already at the top level. No effect for gunners.
Halves sharpness loss: a normal hit has a 50% chance to cost nothing and bigger losses are halved (never below 1), so sharpness lasts about twice as many hits. Switches off Blunt Edge.
Doubles sharpness loss: a normal hit costs 2 points instead of 1, a deflected hit 4 instead of 2. Razor Sharp and the skills that count as it cancel it.
Hits that would bounce land as normal hits instead, costing normal sharpness; only a few attacks can still bounce. Works for Blademaster weapons and the Bow, not the Light or Heavy Bowgun.
Hits that cut only moderately well bounce 1 time in 3, rolled once per attack; the best-cutting hits are never affected. Steady Hand, Nightcloak Soul and Nightcloak Soul X cancel it.
Sharpening starts a 60 s polish: Blademasters lose no sharpness, and gunner shots with the x1.5 distance bonus get x1.75. It also lets Bow and Bowgun users sharpen with whetstones.
Attack x1.2 at red or orange sharpness, x1.15 at yellow, x1.1 at green, no change at blue or better. Blademasters only, and low sharpness still never beats blue.
+100 affinity on draw attacks, so with 0% or more affinity every draw attack is a critical hit. No effect at red sharpness; the Bow always gets it.
Draw attacks can stun and exhaust monsters, and you get +5 attack before multipliers. Cutting weapons only: no effect for the Hammer, Hunting Horn, Bowguns or Bow.
Sheathing plays at x1.4 speed, about 29% faster, for every weapon (two shared sheathe actions excepted). Does not stack with Sheath Control or Rustrazor Soul.
Sheathing while an enraged large monster is in your area has a 35% chance to restore 4 to 16 sharpness, depending on the weapon (least for the Great Sword). No effect for gunners.
Blademasters regain 5 sharpness (7 on some weapons) every few drawn-weapon dodges. Bowgun dodges have a 50% chance of a special effect; a Bow gains or improves Close-Range Coating.
Raises a Bowgun's reload rating by 3 steps, moving every ammo three steps toward the fast reload band, and a Bow loads a coating the moment you select it.
Raises a Bowgun's reload rating by 2 steps, moving every ammo two steps toward the fast reload band, and a Bow loads a coating the moment you select it.
Raises a Bowgun's reload rating by 1 step, which only speeds up ammo sitting right at a band edge, and a Bow loads coatings in 85% of the usual time.
